Subject: POC environment – connectivity stakes, deliverables & close timeline

Jane / Ops team,

Thanks for the productive demo today — appreciate the clarity on your evaluation goals. To keep us on track for the planned July pilot close, I put together a short list of technical deliverables we need to finalize in your MAP so Redwood can provision a production-like POC environment: 

- Org & permission setup: confirm which Medivex AD groups map to the eval org owner + reviewers (we'll create the org and invite users once names are confirmed).
- API keys: we'll create a scoped API key for the POC, and a short-lived sandbox key for initial testing.
- IP allowlist: we need your egress IP ranges (CIDR) so we can add them to the allowlist for the dedicated POC instances.
- VPC peering: confirm whether you want peering to a Medivex VPC or a private peering endpoint — if peering, share VPC ID and owner account.

Proposed commitments and dates (adjustable):
- By Thu 2026-06-11: Medivex to share AD group membership and primary POC contact for org invite.
- By Mon 2026-06-15: Provide IP ranges and VPC details.
- By Wed 2026-06-17: Redwood to share sandbox API key + network diagram and peering checklist.
- By Fri 2026-06-25: Turn up POC instances and run acceptance smoke tests.

Attachments: I attached a first-pass MAP spreadsheet that maps these items to owners and dates. Diego will follow up with the peering checklist and recommended CIDR/ports.

Questions for you now: can you confirm an internal Ops/Networking point-of-contact (name + email)? Also flag any procurement or security signoffs that must happen before we can peer.

Thanks — Naomi

Hey team — quick tech note and checklist from Redwood infra: 

1) IP allowlist and ports
- Recommended egress CIDRs for acceptance: please provide your public egress /24s for our allowlist. We test health checks on TCP 443 and establish peering traffic on ephemeral ports; no inbound ports beyond 443 are required from Medivex to Redwood for the POC.
- If you run strict egress NAT, please confirm SNAT mapping so we can match CIDR.

2) VPC peering prerequisites
- Peering requires: VPC ID, owner account (you shared), preferred subnet (we ask for a private /20 or larger for route propagation), and a contact who can approve peering in your AWS console.
- We will provide a CloudFormation template for the peering routes to minimize manual changes.

3) API keys & quotas
- Sandbox keys: limited to 500k tokens/day by default. For your tokenizer burst tests we can temporarily bump to 2M tokens/day for a 48-hour window; Naomi — confirm if Medivex intends a prolonged stress run.

4) Test plan notes
- Smoke tests we run: auth success, simple generation (<256 tokens),kv/cache prefix validation, and end-to-end latency sampling from your peered subnets.

Attached: medivex-network-diagram.png (diagram of recommended peering routes). Also adding a small JSON snippet (in the drive link) with the CIDR templates we recommend.

I'll schedule a short 30-minute walk-through with Marcus if that helps — propose Fri 2026-06-12 10:00 PT.

— Diego

Hi Jane / Marcus — following up and consolidating the MAP items into a single deliverable for signatures so we can lock the July pilot target.

I've updated the attached MAP spreadsheet with the milestones we discussed and added explicit acceptance criteria for each item:
- Org/setup: Medivex to confirm AD groups and final POC user list. Acceptance = invite accepted and at least one user can authenticate to the POC console.
- API keys: Redwood to provide sandbox key by 2026-06-17. Acceptance = successful tokenized request from Medivex test harness.
- IP allowlist & peering: Medivex to provide CIDRs and approve peering by 2026-06-15. Acceptance = routes propagated and ping/health checks pass from your subnet.
- Security: Redwood to share SOC2 summary and data handling bullet points by 2026-06-18 (legal redlines outside scope here).

Next steps:
1) Marcus — can you confirm the two /24 CIDRs and approve the peering slot by EOD 2026-06-15?
2) Jane — legal expects a short SOW; if you share the DocuSign contact we can prepare the SOW + link.
3) Once the peering is accepted we will schedule the smoke test window (48 hours) and run the checklist; Marissa will coordinate the test kickoff.

I've also attached a link to the MAP (spreadsheet) and a draft SOW PowerForm (DocuSign) for quick signing. Please reply with confirmations so we can mark these as closed in the MAP.

Thanks — Marissa
